title: SyncPush
description: POST /sync/push request: the device replaying its offline queue. Every op was already user-approved and idempotent when queued, so replay order is safe; each op returns per-op result (sync endpoint never fails wholesale — conflicts surface as per-op `conflict` with detail the device turns into the keep-both banner).

payload.description: Shaped like the referenced request schema for that op (`save-capture`, `save-patch`, `note-put`, `folder-write`, `tags-put`, `suggestion-accept`).

device_cursor.description: The device's last pulled server cursor, so the server can short-circuit a no-op replay after a pulled conflict.
